title: Infra quickmap: midshift capacity + net notes
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal map for midshift: things to check, quick fixes, tickets to follow, and ideas to try while latency is elevated. Not a handoff doc — scratch notes.

Top-of-shift checks (15m):
- Check pool headroom: gpu-prod-pool-3 (expect 20% spare), gpu-edge-pool-b (5% spare). If <10% spare, start emergency drain plan.
- Verify autoscaler is healthy: query /api/internal/autoscaler/status -> look for backoff loops.
- Look at preemptions last 1h: `gcloud compute instances operations list --filter="status:TERMINATED" --project=infra-prod` (rough).
- KV cache hit-rate for main-chat-model: dashboard -> model/cache/hits (want >85% for p99 < 80ms).

Immediate TODOs (priority order):
1) INFRA-4273 follow-up (Maya): node swap failed on rack-07 due to NVML mismatch. Quick mitigation: set MIG mode to 1g.
   - Command quick: `ssh ops@rack-07-node12` -> `sudo nvidia-smi -mig -i 0 -cgi 19,19,19 -C` (test on canary i.e. node15).
2) Backfill policy tweak for gpu-edge-pool-b: reduce min-available to 2 for weekdays 23:00-07:00 to avoid noisy neighbor spikes. File PR to infra repo.
3) Network flakiness on subnet eu-west-1a: suspected BGP flap. Trace: `mtr -r -c 100 10.34.12.1` from border node; open ticket with cloud provider if >2% loss.

Observations / anomalies since last run:
- Two short (~20s) latency bumps at 02:48 and 03:14 affecting embedding route; correlates with node drain events from autoscaler. Could be preemptions + cache warm-up.
- Small increase in cold start tokens for long-context jobs (>= 8k). Consider prewarmed pool for those jobs.
- One user complaint (support thread #12345) about streaming cut-out mid-token; logs show 502 from envoy for a few seconds. Check envoy restart schedule.

Quick commands to remember:
- drain a node safely (graceful): `infractl node drain --node rack-09-node03 --timeout 600 --allow-preempt`
- force a cache refresh for model: `infractl cache refresh --model rdm-7b --prefix "session-logs/2026-03-12"`
- check queue depth: `redis-cli -h queue-host llen job_queue_high`

Notes to self / ideas to test (low-effort experiments):
- Try lowering batching threshold for rdm-7b in edge pool during peak to reduce p95 by 30ms; observe cost delta.
- Prototype tiny LRU prefetcher for common prefixes (embedding reuse across reranking). Could reduce token cost by ~8%.
- Add a quick health endpoint that returns KV cache hit rate + earliest eviction time for each model to save digging into dashboards.

Handover bullets (if I get pulled):
- If capacity drops under 15% spare in any production pool, escalate to SRE rotation and open priority incident with ``INC-ops-<timestamp>``.
- Use canary drain pattern: pick node with `tag:canary=true` first; run MIG change; then watch p99 for 10m.

Rough backlog (one-liners):
- PR: reduce eviction age for ephemeral cache from 72h -> 24h (test on staging).
- Cleanup: remove old node labels `temp-2025-ql` from cluster.
- Doc: short writeup on fallback policy when redwood-runtime falls back from rdm-7b-quant4 -> rdm-7b-fp16. Include cost delta table.

Slack / tickets to check (links in linked_artifacts):
- Slack thread: #infra-gpu -> thread about MIG flakiness (Maya posted logs).
- Follow up on JIRA INFRA-4273 (blocking rack-07 swap).

Unresolved questions / debug points:
- Why did node12 report NVML mismatch on a node that had identical AMI? Investigate AMI bake vs nvidia driver version drift.
- Does autoscaler telemetry correctly count in-flight draining pods as freed capacity? Might be double-counting.

One-line plan for next shift:
- Reattempt MIG change on canary node15, monitor KV cache hit-rate and p95 for 30m; if good, roll to node12 and 13.

Random brain dump (scratch):
- If we add a tiny per-model admission controller that gates long-context requests into prewarmed lanes, it could reduce cold-start cost and keep latency predictable. Prototype as library hook in runtime.
- Document latency-correlated events in console dashboards so PMs can correlate model rollouts with infra changes.

End of scratch.
(If nothing urgent, try to finish the PR for edge backfill policy.)
